text:
The GTA 6 leaker is back. And this time, twenty-five minutes of gameplay just dropped.
It is called the Extended Leek.
Racing through Vice City. Dirt bike races. Street races. Vehicle customization.
Even a tank, spawned from what looks like a debug menu.
But here's the twist.
The footage shows first-person driving. And Jason walking around in first person.
Rockstar said the game would not launch with a full first-person mode.
And yes, the internet is losing it over the outfits. Or the lack of them.
We blurred that part.
Remember, this is a debug build. Some of it may never reach the final game.
Rockstar has not commented yet.
Heads up: this is an unofficial leak, not confirmed by Rockstar.
Would you watch it, or wait for November nineteenth? Tell me below.
